hypothesis: Task-bound evidence roles improve correctness under irrelevant changes beyond ordinary redo and exact-question repetition.
scope: Exposed v5 development; original and perturbed ends inferred independently. No paired answer, R label, gold or source ID in head.
controls: All arms one original-backbone call with unchanged full original messages, schema and decoding. No old assistant answer. Repeat isolates the contribution of repeating the target question.
reporting: Native task-to-unit averaging; source strata, reference/variant/both-correct/valid-invariance, repairs/harms, format and document-detection separately. Relevant-change controls separate.
decision: Review both backbones and actual errors; no per-item or per-backbone winner mixture. A pilot is not proof of generalization.
